central_problem: Build a star-schema Power BI dashboard (executive, time, product, customer views) on a small beverage-sales dataset whose fact table (PBI_orders) has revenue stored at order grain but repeated on every order-line row; naive per-row SUM inflates Total Revenue ~8.9x (5,396,656.69 vs correct 606,144.09).

mandatory_data_fixes_before_any_measure.fix: Deduplicate fact_orders to 1 row per order_id before summing revenue (or aggregate revenue via a dimension/table keyed by order_id).
mandatory_data_fixes_before_any_measure.reason: orders.revenue is constant per order_id (0/356 orders with >1 distinct revenue value).

mandatory_data_fixes_before_any_measure.fix: DISTINCT on all 5 columns of PBI_orders before any line-level count (removes 9 fully-duplicated rows).
DISTINCT on item_id (+ category) in PBI_items before using as dim_product (removes 99 duplicated item_id / 94 fully-duplicate rows; verified 0 category conflicts).
Build De-Para for city: SP->São Paulo, RJ->Rio de Janeiro, Campinas unchanged; 1 null user city -> 'Not informed' (not dropped).
Flag November 2024 as partial month (data only through 2024-11-10) in any date dimension / measure that supports MoM or YTD.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.formula: SUM(revenue) over DISTINCT order_id (order grain, not order-line grain)
limitations: Currency/unit not confirmed by source PDF or data.

kpis.name: Average Ticket
kpis.decision: 40 zero-revenue orders (3 restaurant customers) are KEPT in numerator and denominator by default — no evidence they are load errors.
limitations: Decision on revenue=0 orders is a registered assumption, not a data certainty.

kpis.name: Month-over-Month Growth %
kpis.required_treatment: Every visual showing MoM must flag November 2024 as a partial month (data through day 10 only). January has no prior month (must render N.A., not 0%).

kpis.name: Year-to-Date Revenue
kpis.formula: Cumulative SUM of Total Revenue measure from January through selected/current month
kpis.required_treatment: Label as 'YTD through 2024-11-10 (partial month)' when November is included.
limitations: Single year of data — no YTD year-over-year comparison possible.

kpis.name: Top 5 Products
kpis.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) grouped by product_id, top 5 descending
kpis.reformulated_from: Top 5 products by revenue (requested in case PDF)
kpis.reason_for_reformulation: orders.revenue is order-grain only; no unit price or per-item allocation exists in raw data. Exact per-product revenue is not computable.
kpis.mandatory_label: Must be displayed as 'Top 5 Products by order frequency' — never formatted as currency or titled 'revenue'.
kpis.rejected_alternative: Equal-split allocation of order revenue across its line items — tested and formally rejected (docs/discovery/revenue_allocation_test.md): median CV 60% across 131 testable products, 49121 (beer, 116 orders) implied price ranging R$32.58-R$11,465.11 (~350x), 'nab' category implied-price max/min ratio of 2,146x and higher average than beer/liquor (inverting the pricing hypothesis), and a single outlier order (7001094580, R$125,476.66, 14 line items) contaminating 14 products with an inflated implied price. Decision: final, confirmed by project owner on 2026-10-02 — frequency is the sole official ranking criterion.
kpis.footer_disclaimer: Este ranking mostra os produtos que aparecem no maior número de pedidos — não os que geram mais receita. Os dados de origem registram apenas o valor total de cada pedido, não o preço de cada item, então não é possível calcular receita por produto individual. Testamos dividir a receita igualmente entre os itens do pedido como alternativa, mas o resultado foi inconsistente (preços implícitos variando até 350x para o mesmo produto) e foi descartado. Por isso, o critério oficial do Top 5 é frequência em pedidos.
kpis.footer_disclaimer_placement: Fixed, non-dismissible banner on the Product Analysis page (same treatment as the n=8 sample-size banner on Customer Analysis) — must not be removable/hidden by any filter.

kpis.name: Revenue vs Target
kpis.formula: Total Revenue(user_id, period) / (targets.'monthly revenue target' * count_of_complete_months_in_period)
limitations: targets has a single monthly value per customer with no month dimension — treated as a constant monthly target across the whole period, an unconfirmed assumption.

kpis.name: Order Lines by Product Category
kpis.formula: COUNT(order lines) grouped by items.category, joined orders.product_id = items.item_id (deduplicated items)
kpis.mandatory_label: Must be titled 'Order lines by category' or 'Category presence in orders' — never 'Revenue by category'.
kpis.null_handling: 5 item_id with null category (incl. item_id 19045, which has recorded sales) shown as explicit 'Category not informed' bucket, not dropped.

explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.gap: No unit price or revenue allocation per product line exists in raw data; exact product-level revenue is not computable. Equal-split allocation was tested as an alternative and formally rejected for statistical unreliability (docs/discovery/revenue_allocation_test.md).
explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.resolution: Reformulated as Top 5 Products by order frequency, explicitly labeled as such in every visual. Final, confirmed by project owner on 2026-10-02 — not open for re-decision.

explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.case_requirement: Product-level revenue analysis in general (Product Analysis page)
explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.resolution: Product Analysis page uses order-line frequency and category presence counts, never currency-formatted product revenue.

explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.gap: Only 8 distinct customers in the entire dataset.
explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.resolution: Mandatory, non-dismissible banner on Customer Analysis page stating the sample-size limitation; no causal or generalizable claims.

explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.gap: Single calendar year (2024) only, no prior-year data.
explicit_gaps_not_sustainable_by_data.resolution: Only month-over-month and YTD implemented; YoY explicitly out of scope, documented in Conclusion tab.

required_interactivity.case_requirement: Two different charts that overlap and are displayed according to the selected chart type
required_interactivity.implementation: Toggle between monthly Revenue (line) and monthly Order Count (column), same time axis, single chart-type selector.

required_interactivity.case_requirement: Single chart with a toggle between absolute values and percentages
required_interactivity.implementation: Revenue by customer, toggle between absolute R$ and % share of total revenue.
